verdict.rationale: ClickHouse documents running the engine on your own machine to build and test. Options include a single-binary quick install, clickhouse-local without a full server, and clickhousectl to launch and manage local servers. The open-source DBMS is described as self-runnable on a single desktop and in official Docker images. However, the evidence never explicitly states that local use needs no account or key, works fully offline, or is intended for CI test pipelines, so story coverage is incomplete. missing for 10: explicit documentation that local use requires no account or API key and has no cloud or network dependency, documented CI/test-harness usage guidance, and independent hands-on corroboration of offline CI use.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the same engine locally and keylessly — no account or cloud dependency — for offline development and CI tests
